title: Use the Accounts Receivable report
summary: Each patient's balance: what was invoiced, what was collected and what they owe.

steps.title: Menu → Reports → Accounts Receivable
steps.details: Each patient's balance: what was invoiced, what was collected and what they owe.

steps.title: Currency
steps.details: Only if the clinic works with two currencies: all or one.

steps.title: Filters
steps.details: Currency and status (owing, up to date, in credit).

steps.title: Generate
steps.details: Calculates the report with the chosen filters.

steps.title: No data
steps.details: There's no data for those filters: try another period.

steps.title: Indicators
steps.details: Total invoiced, total collected, net balance and how many patients owe.

steps.title: Results
steps.details: One row per patient with their balance; tap the name to go to their record.

steps.title: Details
steps.details: Sort by column by tapping the header.

steps.title: Export
steps.details: Excel, CSV or PDF with what you're viewing.
